data.body: **[P2] Classify transport failures as fixture errors.** Botocore transport exceptions such as `ReadTimeoutError` bypass this handler. If a losing branch encounters one after `WINNER_READY`, the gate emits only `IO_INTERRUPTED` and `IO_EXIT`. The existing SDK can then finish joining that failed branch within the grace period, and `early_completion()` accepts it as successful reclamation because no `CONTROL_ERROR` or `ESCAPE` exists. Treat transport failures from gate I/O as infrastructure errors, and add a negative control injecting a transport failure after winner readiness.
